chapter: New Orleans style and bass playing
title: Making chord changes and playing for clarinet and trombone
summary: He sometimes puts in his own chords, plays soft four beats under a low clarinet, and switches between four and two for the trombonist Louis Nelson.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique
